Vertical activity feed (the Gavel `TimelineCard`): each event has a tone-colored icon disc joined by a connector rail, an actor/action/time line, and an optional body bubble for threaded detail. Domain-agnostic — callers compose `bodyHeader` (e.g. a file anchor + status `Badge`) and `body` themselves.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/Timeline.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { Timeline } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/data";
```
